description: This file defines the StatusWindow class responsible for creating and managing a GUI window that displays status messages, including a log area and a driver download link.

classes.name: StatusWindow
classes.description: Main class managing a GUI window with a status log and driver link.

methods.name: StatusWindow
methods.description: Constructor initializing the status window components.

methods.name: getFrameHelper
methods.description: Returns the FrameHelper instance managing the frame.

methods.name: showFrame
methods.description: Displays the window with a specified title and centers it.

methods.name: appendMsg
methods.description: Appends a message to the log area asynchronously.
